evidence.observation: O2 begins rising from ~5-6 ppm baseline during growth
O2 monotonically climbs 6.7→13.4→20.3→25.9→33.3 ppm despite steady 100 sccm Ar
Ar flow stable at setpoint, so rise is not a purge-flow loss
Pressure steady ~760 Torr, no exhaust blockage signature
Temperature holds 750 °C at setpoint, control nominal

args.missing_evidence: Continued O2 trend and a leak-check (e.g., raise Ar flow: a true leak dilutes, a real O2 source scales differently), plus post-run film characterization.
